how_to_check: Run each recompute command from the repo root.

claims.meaning: Business actions in the catalog, one JSON file each.
Actions with status `verified`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Actions with status `observed`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Actions with status `gated`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Actions with status `failed`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Actions with status `seen`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Actions with status `documented`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Verified actions that change data. Each one has a read-back that confirmed the change.
Verified writes with no read-back. Must be 0.
claims.recompute: jq -s '[.[] | select(.verification.status == "verified" and .operation_class != "read" and .postcondition == null)] | length' catalog/actions/*.json

claims.meaning: Actions that need the user's OK before they run: sends, deletes and writes that nothing can undo.
Calls made to the live Brevo API. Each is one line in the evidence log.
Business actions found in the web app walk.
Catalog actions behind the web app actions. One action can serve several buttons.
Web app actions whose catalog action runs through the public API.
Mistakes logged while building the catalog.
Logged mistakes that name the automated check that now catches them.
claims.recompute: jq -s '[.[] | select(.now_checked_by != null or .check != null)] | length' docs/corrections.jsonl

claims.meaning: Errors from the catalog lint. Must be 0.
